title:
Helper type for inferring the return type of Data APIs in the case where return type is ambiguous. This
allows to to avoid pre-execution of Data APIs and preserve laziness. To enable return type inference for a
particular Data API, create a method with the following naming
scheme: <name of method><name of type method is on>. These methods must all have the same arguments:
the method being called as a string, the parent object we are calling this method on, and all arguments being
passed into the method as a map. This method will return the inferred type, or `null` if the type cannot be
inferred (in which case the API will be pre-executed to determine return type)
name: Data.ReturnTypeInferer
